items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: was a thrill to me to be picked to play in his company and to be picked as a side man.

ctx.x: With Slam, he injected great humor in our style, and of course Errol Garner was contributing his great new piano style, and Clyde Hart on piano with us, was a great underrated musician, also. Billie Holiday used him on some of her records and Don Byas, another one of a kind tenor
player, with such intense feeling and tone, was a thrill to me to be picked to play in his company and to be picked as a side man.

At this period, the war in Europe was building to a climax, and the major cities blacked out after 11 P.M. hey were -- the Germans were sending the bomb into England at that time, and they were afraid it might reach into the United States in some of our big cities. So anyway, New York was blacked out, and it was an eerie feeling to go to work on 52nd Street at four o'clock in the afternoon with the sunshine blinding us, we had to rearrange our drinking habits and our bar appointments with the bartenders at the…
